sections.h2: Indian Lakes Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 240 residential sales closed in Indian Lakes (Virginia Beach, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $325,250, close to the citywide median of $405,000, and homes took a median of 16 days to sell, about the same pace as the citywide median of 15 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Indian Lakes sales closed between $268,750 and $395,625, or about $225 per square foot against $240 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($331,000, 110 sales) was about 3% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($320,000, 130 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

Recent Indian Lakes sales were in ZIP code 23464.

sections.h2: What Stands Out About Indian Lakes
sections.html: 22% of Indian Lakes sales had four or more bedrooms, against 40% citywide. The median Indian Lakes home is about 1,400 square feet, smaller than the 1,706 square foot citywide median. 48% of Indian Lakes homes sold for more than their list price, versus 36% citywide, so competing offers were more common than in the typical neighborhood.

sections.h2: When Indian Lakes Homes Sell and How Far Prices Range
sections.html:
Closings in Indian Lakes were busiest in April (28 sales across the two years) and slowest in October (12 sales). Sold prices ran from $115,000 to $495,000, a spread of 4.3x between the lowest and highest sale. 85% of homes closed at or above list price and 2% closed at least 5% below it.

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Indian Lakes
sections.html:
50% of the sales were detached homes and 50% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 1,400 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,199 to 1,760 square feet. 50% of the homes that sold had 3 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 1976 and 1986, with a median year built of 1983, so this is mostly homes from the 1970s through the 1990s.
